_meta.description: FDD Tools Database - comprehensive catalog of tools for Forward Deployed Directors working with nonprofits, startups, and founders

categories.grants: Grant discovery, application, and management platforms
categories.communications: Email marketing, social media, and design
categories.ai: AI tools for productivity and automation

tools.name: JustFund
tools.description: Streamlined grant management platform connecting nonprofits with funders through a common application system
tools.whenToUse: When applying for grants from foundations that use JustFund, creating a reusable organizational profile, or managing grant reporting
tools.fddNotes: Create org profile FIRST with all attachments (990, determination letter, budget). Profile reusable across all JustFund funders. Great for smaller foundations.

tools.name: Submittable
tools.description: Application management platform used by many foundations and government funders for grant applications
tools.whenToUse: When applying for grants from organizations using Submittable, managing multiple grant applications, or tracking application status
tools.fddNotes: Create account with org email. Many arts, government, and community foundations use this. Check their opportunity listings.

tools.name: Instrumentl
tools.description: Grant discovery and tracking platform with AI-powered matching to find relevant funding opportunities
tools.whenToUse: When researching new grant opportunities, building a grants calendar, or tracking application deadlines
tools.fddNotes: Worth the investment for orgs actively pursuing grants. Set up saved searches for org's focus areas. Export matches to grants calendar.

tools.name: Candid (GuideStar + Foundation Directory)
tools.description: Nonprofit transparency platform (GuideStar profiles) and foundation research database (Foundation Directory)
tools.whenToUse: Claiming/updating GuideStar profile, researching foundations, verifying nonprofit status, building funder prospect lists

pricing.notes: Basic profile free; Foundation Directory requires subscription ($99-$199/mo)

tools.fddNotes: CRITICAL: Claim GuideStar profile immediately. Complete to Gold/Platinum level. Funders check this. Foundation Directory useful for prospect research.

tools.name: QuickBooks Online
tools.description: Cloud-based accounting software with nonprofit-specific features and fund accounting capabilities
tools.whenToUse: Managing day-to-day bookkeeping, tracking expenses by program/grant, generating financial reports, preparing for audits
tools.fddNotes: Set up Chart of Accounts with fund accounting structure from day 1. Enable class tracking for programs/grants. Connect bank feeds immediately.

tools.name: Xero
tools.description: Cloud accounting platform with strong multi-currency support and clean interface
tools.whenToUse: Alternative to QuickBooks, especially for orgs with international operations or those preferring a cleaner UI
tools.fddNotes: Good QuickBooks alternative. Tracking categories work well for fund accounting. Consider if org has international transactions.

tools.name: Bill.com
tools.description: AP/AR automation platform for managing vendor payments, approvals, and invoice processing
tools.whenToUse: Streamlining bill payments, implementing approval workflows, managing vendor relationships, automating recurring payments
tools.fddNotes: Essential for orgs with multiple approvers or remote teams. Set up approval workflows matching org's financial policies. Connects to QBO.

tools.name: Stripe
tools.description: Payment processing platform with nonprofit pricing and robust API for custom donation flows
tools.whenToUse: Processing online donations, setting up recurring giving, integrating payments into website or custom apps
tools.fddNotes: Apply for nonprofit rate. Great for custom donation pages or integrating with website. Pair with Stripe Checkout for quick setup.

tools.name: PayPal Giving Fund
tools.description: PayPal's charitable giving platform that enables donations through PayPal, Venmo, and fundraising integrations
tools.whenToUse: Accepting PayPal/Venmo donations, participating in PayPal campaigns, enabling peer-to-peer fundraising
tools.fddNotes: Enroll to receive donations from Facebook Fundraisers and PayPal campaigns. Verify 501(c)(3) status required. Disbursements monthly.

tools.name: Salesforce Nonprofit Success Pack (NPSP)
tools.description: Enterprise CRM with nonprofit-specific data model for donor management, grants tracking, and program management
tools.whenToUse: Managing donor relationships at scale, tracking grant applications, program outcomes tracking, orgs with complex data needs

pricing.notes: 10 free licenses through Power of Us program; additional at nonprofit pricing

tools.fddNotes: Powerful but complex. Best for orgs with $500K+ budget or dedicated data person. Apply for Power of Us (free licenses). Consider implementation partner.

tools.name: Bloomerang
tools.description: Donor management CRM focused on retention with engagement scoring and simple interface
tools.whenToUse: Small-to-mid sized nonprofits needing donor tracking, engagement scoring, and retention-focused analytics
tools.fddNotes: Great for orgs outgrowing spreadsheets. Engagement meter helps prioritize outreach. Simpler than Salesforce. Good donor retention focus.

tools.name: Little Green Light
tools.description: Affordable donor management system with solid core features and reasonable learning curve
tools.whenToUse: Budget-conscious orgs needing donor tracking, gift processing, and basic reporting without enterprise complexity
tools.fddNotes: Best value in donor CRM space. Good for orgs with $100K-$500K budget. Import from spreadsheets easy. Solid support.

tools.name: day.ai
tools.description: AI-native CRM created by HubSpot founders that automates CRM work without manual data entry
tools.whenToUse: Organizations wanting CRM functionality with minimal data entry overhead, automated relationship tracking, and AI-powered insights
tools.fddNotes: AI-native approach eliminates traditional CRM data entry burden. Created by HubSpot founders, so strong CRM DNA. Worth evaluating for orgs frustrated with manual CRM maintenance.

tools.name: Google Workspace for Nonprofits
tools.description: Full Google suite (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Meet, Calendar) with nonprofit-specific features and pricing
tools.whenToUse: Setting up org email, document collaboration, video meetings, shared calendars, team file storage

pricing.notes: Free Business Starter for eligible nonprofits through Google for Nonprofits

tools.fddNotes: FOUNDATIONAL. Apply for Google for Nonprofits FIRST. Gets you free Workspace, Google Ad Grants ($10K/mo), YouTube nonprofit features.

tools.name: Microsoft 365 for Nonprofits
tools.description: Microsoft productivity suite with nonprofit licensing through Tech Soup
tools.whenToUse: Organizations preferring Microsoft ecosystem, needing advanced Excel, or with Windows-centric infrastructure

pricing.notes: Free Business Basic; discounted Business Premium through Tech Soup

tools.fddNotes: Alternative to Google. Better if org already uses Windows/Office heavily. Apply through Tech Soup for licensing.

tools.name: Notion
tools.description: All-in-one workspace for notes, docs, wikis, project management, and databases
tools.whenToUse: Creating internal wikis, project tracking, meeting notes, SOPs, lightweight database needs, team documentation

pricing.notes: Free for small teams; Plus $10/user/month; 50% nonprofit discount

tools.fddNotes: Great for org knowledge base and SOPs. Use for board materials, program documentation. Apply for nonprofit discount. Don't over-engineer.

tools.name: Slack
tools.description: Team communication platform with channels, direct messages, and extensive integrations
tools.whenToUse: Real-time team communication, reducing email, integrating tool notifications, external partner collaboration
tools.fddNotes: Apply for Slack for Nonprofits (85% discount). Set up channels by project/team. Don't create too many channels. Good for external partners via Slack Connect.

tools.name: Asana
tools.description: Project management platform for tracking tasks, projects, and team workload
tools.whenToUse: Managing projects with multiple tasks/assignees, tracking recurring work, visualizing team capacity, event planning

pricing.notes: Free for up to 15 users; 50% nonprofit discount on paid plans

tools.fddNotes: Great for program teams managing events or campaigns. Use templates for recurring projects. Apply for nonprofit discount.

tools.name: Zoom
tools.description: Video conferencing platform with webinar capabilities and broad compatibility
tools.whenToUse: Virtual meetings, webinars, board meetings, hybrid events, one-on-one calls with donors/partners
tools.fddNotes: Apply for Zoom for Nonprofits discount. Consider Pro for board meetings (no 40-min limit). Webinar add-on useful for events.

tools.name: ngrok
tools.description: Secure tunnel to expose local development servers to the internet for webhook testing and development
tools.whenToUse: Testing webhooks locally (calendar integrations, Retell AI callbacks), exposing local APIs for external services, development and staging environments

pricing.notes: Free tier with random URLs; paid plans for static domains and longer sessions

tools.fddNotes: Essential for local webhook development. Use for calendar watch setup and Retell webhook testing. Free tier sufficient for development. Remember URLs change on restart unless paid plan.

tools.name: Mailchimp
tools.description: Email marketing platform with automation, templates, and audience management
tools.whenToUse: Sending newsletters, donor communications, event announcements, building email lists, basic automation

pricing.notes: Free up to 500 contacts; 15% nonprofit discount on paid

tools.fddNotes: Good starting point for email. Set up segments (donors, volunteers, general). Use tags for interests. Migrate to dedicated CRM email as you grow.

tools.name: Canva
tools.description: Design platform with templates for social media, presentations, reports, and marketing materials
tools.whenToUse: Creating social graphics, annual reports, event flyers, presentations, brand materials without a designer

pricing.notes: Canva for Nonprofits: Free Pro access for eligible 501(c)(3)s

tools.fddNotes: APPLY FOR CANVA FOR NONPROFITS. Free Pro worth $120/year. Create brand kit with colors/fonts. Set up templates for common needs.

tools.name: Logo.dev
tools.description: API service providing access to millions of company logos for integration into applications, websites, and marketing materials
tools.whenToUse: Pulling partner logos for websites, proposals, reports, or partner pages; displaying company logos in CRM or partner directories; automating logo updates when companies rebrand

pricing.notes: Free Community plan (500K requests/month with attribution); Startup $280/year (1M requests, no attribution); Pro $1,260/year (5M requests)

tools.fddNotes: Great for partner pages, proposals, and reports. Free tier sufficient for most orgs. Fetch logos by domain, company name, or ticker. Logos auto-update on rebrand. Simple img tag integration.

tools.name: Buffer
tools.description: Social media scheduling and analytics platform for managing multiple accounts
tools.whenToUse: Scheduling social posts in advance, managing multiple social accounts, basic social analytics

pricing.notes: Free for 3 channels; 50% nonprofit discount on paid

tools.fddNotes: Good for orgs posting 3+ times/week. Schedule content monthly. Apply for nonprofit discount. Alternative: Later for Instagram-heavy orgs.

tools.name: DocuSign
tools.description: Electronic signature platform for contracts, board resolutions, and legal documents
tools.whenToUse: Getting contracts signed remotely, board resolutions, grant agreements, vendor contracts, employment documents
tools.fddNotes: Essential for remote operations. Use for board consents, contracts, offer letters. Check Tech Soup for discounts. Alternative: HelloSign/Dropbox Sign.

tools.name: Boardable
tools.description: Board management platform for meeting scheduling, document sharing, and governance
tools.whenToUse: Managing board meetings, sharing materials, tracking attendance, storing governance documents
tools.fddNotes: Good for orgs with active boards. Centralizes materials, tracks attendance. Alternative: Board portal in Notion if budget-constrained.

tools.name: Gusto
tools.description: Payroll and HR platform with benefits administration, onboarding, and compliance features
tools.whenToUse: Running payroll, managing benefits, onboarding employees, state tax compliance, contractor payments
tools.fddNotes: Best-in-class for small nonprofits. Handles multi-state compliance automatically. Set up as soon as you have employees. Connects to QBO.

tools.name: Justworks
tools.description: PEO providing payroll, benefits, HR, and compliance as a bundled service
tools.whenToUse: When you want enterprise-level benefits for a small team, need HR support, or want to outsource compliance entirely
tools.fddNotes: Consider if org wants to offer competitive benefits without HR staff. More expensive than Gusto but more hands-off. Good for 5+ employees.

tools.name: TechSoup
tools.description: Technology donation and discount marketplace for nonprofits - gateway to discounted software
tools.whenToUse: Getting discounts on Microsoft, Adobe, hardware, and other software; validating nonprofit status for other platforms

pricing.notes: Free to join; small admin fees on products

tools.fddNotes: REGISTER IMMEDIATELY. TechSoup validation required for many nonprofit discounts. Check product catalog quarterly. Great for hardware donations too.

tools.name: Claude (Anthropic)
tools.description: AI assistant for writing, analysis, coding, and research with strong reasoning capabilities
tools.whenToUse: Grant writing assistance, drafting communications, analyzing data, research, brainstorming, coding help
tools.fddNotes: Director's preferred AI. Use for grant narrative drafts, board report outlines, research synthesis. Always review/edit AI output. Don't share sensitive data.

tools.name: Zapier
tools.description: Automation platform connecting apps and creating workflows without code
tools.whenToUse: Automating repetitive tasks, connecting tools that don't integrate natively, creating notification workflows
tools.fddNotes: Start with simple zaps: new donation → thank you email, form submission → CRM. Apply for nonprofit discount. Don't over-automate early.

tools.name: Skyvern
tools.description: AI browser agent that automates form filling and web workflows by understanding and interacting with websites like a human
tools.whenToUse: Automating repetitive form submissions (grant applications, registrations, compliance filings), bulk data entry across web portals, filling out applications on platforms without APIs
tools.fddNotes: INTERNAL FDD TOOL. Use for bulk grant application submissions, filling out JustFund/Submittable profiles, state compliance filings. Can handle sites that block traditional automation. Pair with grant profiles JSON for autofill data.

tools.name: Retell AI
tools.description: Voice AI platform for creating conversational AI agents that can make and receive phone calls with natural speech
tools.whenToUse: Automated phone calls for meeting debriefs, follow-up calls, appointment reminders, customer support, or any phone-based AI interaction

pricing.notes: Pay per minute of conversation; phone number rental fees

tools.fddNotes: Used for meeting debrief agent that calls executives post-meeting. Configure agent with custom prompts. CRITICAL: Disable recording for security. Set up webhook for transcript capture. Use ngrok for local webhook testing.

tools.name: Givebutter
tools.description: All-in-one fundraising platform with donation pages, events, auctions, and peer-to-peer tools
tools.whenToUse: Online fundraising campaigns, event ticketing, peer-to-peer fundraising, auctions, recurring donations

pricing.notes: No platform fees; optional donor tip; 2.9% + $0.30 processing

tools.fddNotes: Great for events and campaigns. No monthly fee model is attractive for small orgs. Use for galas, peer-to-peer, crowdfunding. Modern UX.

tools.name: IRS Tax Exempt Organization Search
tools.description: Official IRS database to verify 501(c)(3) status and view organization information
tools.whenToUse: Verifying nonprofit status, checking determination letter date, researching other nonprofits, due diligence
tools.fddNotes: Use to verify your org appears correctly. Check after any IRS correspondence. Useful for vetting fiscal sponsors or partner orgs.
